config.expected_if_false: In at least one seed, the final force margin is < 0.1 against best-of-5 controls (the earlier 0.22 margins were single-control artifacts), or the force margin at step 5000 is within 0.03 of its step-500 value in both seeds (no late formation).
config.expected_if_true: In both seeds, the final force margin over the best-of-5 control is >= max(0.1, control_spread) at some layer, and the force margin read from the per-checkpoint trajectory first stays at or above the bar persistently at step >= 1000. accel_step is already persistently above its bar at the first checkpoint (step 500). The force margin at step 5000 exceeds the step-500 force margin by >= 0.08 in both seeds.
config.hypothesis: Physical force forms late. In long-trained 4-layer d_model=128 models (5000 steps, e in [0, 0.5], m2 in [0.1, 1]), the force probe beats a best-of-5 random control at the end of training, and its persistent formation step comes well after accel_step's. Earlier single-control runs (f-20261011-201533-0653) showed the force margin growing from ~0.1 to ~0.22 over 4000 steps. Every best-of-5 run so far stopped at 300-600 steps and showed no lasting force margin (0.00-0.08).
